blocks.text: Potholes used for the purpose of locating, accessing or repairing buried utilities shall be as
noted below or as necessary to protect existing utilities.
a) Positively identify (by potholing) all crossed utilities that are expected to be as follows:
▸ Above and within 5' of the proposed vertical alignment,
▸ Below and within 3' of the proposed vertical alignment
b) Positively identify (by potholing) all parallel utilities at the beginning and ending of all
▸ Every 200' if it is within 5' of the proposed alignment,
▸ Every 50' if it is within 3' of the proposed alignment
